title.en: Cement screed floor inside a wooden shed

alt.tr: Çimento şapı dökülmüş ahşap kulübe zemini, arkada lambri kaplı duvar ve önünde çim zemin
alt.en: Wooden shed interior with a smooth cement screed floor, paneled back wall and grass in front

caption.tr: Ahşap kulübenin iç zemini düz çimento şapla kaplandı. Duvarlar lambri kaplama, dışarıda çimen var.
caption.en: The inside floor of the wooden shed has been finished with a flat cement screed. The walls are clad in tongue-and-groove boards, with lawn outside.
